function removeQualifiersAndReferences(entity, propertyId)
    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]
    if statements then
        for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do
            statement["qualifiers"] = nil
            statement["references"] = nil
        end
    end
end

function restoreQualifiersAndReferences(originalStatements, cloneOfStatements)
    for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
        cloneOfStatement["qualifiers"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["qualifiers"]
        cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]
    end
end

function getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId)
    local originalStatements = entity.claims[propertyId]
    if not originalStatements then
        return {}
    end

    removeQualifiersAndReferences(entity, propertyId)

    local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(originalStatements)

    restoreQualifiersAndReferences(originalStatements, cloneOfStatements)

    return cloneOfStatements
end
